notes: Backend batch item 1 of 3 (no-migration set). Fixes the fragile contract↔influencer join flagged in the brand-web audit. Root cause: GET /contracts/brand/pending (listBrandPending) already JOINs campaign_influencers but never SELECTed campaign_influencer_id, so the hub had to match pending contracts to creators by a coalesced/lower-cased/@-stripped Instagram-handle STRING — which silently mis-matches or drops a contract when a handle is missing, renamed or duplicated, on the surface that LOCKS BRAND FUNDS at counter-sign. Fix: add con.campaign_influencer_id to the SELECT (purely additive, no filter/shape change, no migration) + hub matches by id with the handle map kept as a rollout fallback. PRODUCTION-IMPACTING: push deploys Render (backend) + Vercel (web). Remaining no-migration items: campaign-summary endpoint, campaign-level production list. Migration items (creator post analytics, post_id sales attribution, discovery thumbnails/audience) are held for explicit founder go with SQL shown first.
